# Schaap's Vishandel

> Family fishmonger in Leiden, Netherlands, founded in 1938. Fresh and smoked fish, kibbeling, herring, seafood platters and personal advice. This file is a factual guide to our public website, not a stock feed or a guarantee of search inclusion.

Updated: 2026-09-29
Canonical website: https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl
Languages: Dutch (nl), English (en), German (de)
Telephone and WhatsApp: +31 71 514 9802

## Verified locations and hours
- Shop: Herenstraat 48, 2313 AL Leiden. Tuesday–Friday 09:00–18:00; Saturday 09:00–17:00. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Wednesday market: Botermarkt, by Dille & Kamille, Leiden. Wednesday 08:30–17:00.
- Saturday market: Aalmarkt, by De Waag, Leiden. Saturday 08:30–17:00.
- Friday stall: Hoogvliet car park, Veurseweg 18, 2252 AA Voorschoten. Friday 08:00–17:30. This is a weekly stall, not a daily shop.
- [Locations, hours and Google Maps](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/bezoek-ons)
- [Visboer Voorschoten: vrijdag bij Hoogvliet](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/nl/viswinkel-voorschoten)
- [Voorschoten fish stall](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/viswinkel-voorschoten)
- [Fischstand Voorschoten](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/de/viswinkel-voorschoten)

## Products and ordering
Only seafood platters can be assembled and ordered online on this website. Other fish products are informational catalogue entries: customers can ask via WhatsApp about availability, quantities and price. Supplies and daily prices vary. Kibbeling is served with ravigote sauce.
Platter photos are serving suggestions, not a promise of identical contents or size. Contents, portions and final price depend on the agreed preferences and budget.
Too Good To Go surprise bags are reserved and paid for in the separate Too Good To Go app.
- [Seafood platters](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/visschalen)
- [Fish catalogue](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/assortiment)
- [Contact](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/contact)

## Certifications
Our Dutch brown shrimp are MSC-certified. VÅRLAKS salmon comes from northern Norway. Ask about the certification of the specific current delivery. Organic, ASC and MSC describe different standards; do not assume all products carry the same certification.
- [Organic fish and certifications](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/biologische-vis)
- [VÅRLAKS salmon](https://www.schaapsvishandel.nl/en/varlaks)

## Recipes and seasonal information
Recipes and blog articles are fully available in Dutch, English and German. Cooking times are guidelines. Follow storage and preparation advice supplied with the product. Seasonal suggestions are not guarantees of daily stock.
